files.description: The primary (b)(10) EHI export documentation. A 2-page PDF: page 1 is a cover page, page 2 describes three export formats (C-CDA, FHIR, Excel/PDF). No data dictionary or field-level specifications for the Excel/PDF exports. Created Nov 2023 by Ahmed Tariq.

The (g)(10) FHIR API documentation, referenced from the (b)(10) PDF as the specification for the FHIR export format. 121 pages covering SMART on FHIR authentication, Bulk Data export, and all US Core FHIR resources (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Immunization, MedicationRequest, Observations, Procedure, etc.). Created May 2023.

An older/simpler API documentation (IPClinical API v5.0, 8 pages). Describes a proprietary REST API that returns patient data as C-CDA XML. Covers authentication, patient search, and data retrieval with USCDI v1 data classes. Created March 2024 but references 2021 copyright.
